packages.vo: Iceblade Sorcerer Season 2 just recast one of its leads. Elisa Griffith is now voiced by Miyu Kubota, replacing original actor Nana Harumura, who retired from voice acting in January for health reasons. This isn't a story twist. It's a real cast change, and every other principal actor is returning exactly as before. Season 2 also brings a new character, Olivia Arnold, and a studio change from Cloud Hearts to Zero-G. The season premieres October eighth on TBS, with Crunchyroll simulcasting. Would you want a full recast, or would you rather the studio just delay the season until the original actor could return? Leave your take.
vo_fact_beats: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2 premieres October 8, 2026 at 1:23 a.m. on TBS, with an additional broadcast October 9 at 11:00 p.m.; Crunchyroll streams it as it airs (Anime News Network, Aug 20, 2026, https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-08-20/the-iceblade-sorcerer-shall-rule-the-world-tv-anime-2nd-season-reveals-october-8-debut-theme-song-/.240752).

Elisa Griffith, one of Ray White's core friend group, is being recast: Miyu Kubota takes over the role, replacing Nana Harumura, who retired from voice acting in January 2026 due to health reasons (same ANN source).

The rest of the main cast returns: Junya Enoki (Ray White), Iori Saeki (Amelia Rose), Akira Sekine (Ariane Olgren), Azumi Waki (Rebecca Bradley), Kaede Hondo (Clarisse Cleveland), Yuichiro Umehara (Evi Armstrong), Kohei Amasaki (Albert Allium), Atsumi Tanezaki (Stella White) -- plus a new character, Olivia Arnold, voiced by Hana Hishikawa (same ANN source).

Production also changed studios: Zero-G animates Season 2, taking over from Cloud Hearts (Season 1); character designer Mariko Kawamoto replaces Makoto Shimojima; director Masahiro Takata returns (same ANN source).

Season 1 (Jan 2023) followed Ray White, the war hero known as the Iceblade Sorcerer, hiding his identity as a commoner student at the elite Arnold Academy, ending after his group defeated the Eugenics organization's plot against Rebecca Bradley (IMDb episode guide, https://www.imdb.com/title/tt25531288/episodes/; Anime News Network encyclopedia, https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=25582).

packages.hook_line: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 is skipping Crunchyroll completely.
packages.opening_sentence: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 is skipping Crunchyroll completely.
packages.vo: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 is skipping Crunchyroll completely. It streams early on ABEMA starting September thirtieth, then makes its TV debut October seventh, with HIDIVE carrying it in North America as it airs. Crunchyroll isn't part of the plan this season. HIDIVE is holding the North American premiere tomorrow at Anime NYC, with director Shinji Ishihira and producers Yosuke Shimada and Genta Ozaki on the panel. A manga spinoff, Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita My Dish, launches the same day as the early stream. Does it bother you when a sequel switches platforms, or do you just follow the show wherever it goes? Leave your take.
vo_fact_beats: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 streams early on ABEMA starting September 30, with a Japanese TV debut October 7 on Tokyo MX and ABC TV; HIDIVE is confirmed as the platform streaming it as it airs outside Japan, with no Crunchyroll involvement this time (Anime News Network, Aug 16, 2026, https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-08-16/reincarnated-as-a-sword-season-2-reveals-september-30-early-streaming-debut-theme-songs-in-trailer/.240622).

This is a change from Season 1, which streamed on HIDIVE as well but is more broadly known through Crunchyroll's back-catalog licensing; Season 2's simulcast rights are exclusively HIDIVE, per NBCUniversal Anime/Music's own promotional rollout (GameTrader.SG, Aug 16, 2026, https://www.gametrader.sg/blog/tag/reincarnated-as-a-sword/; Crunchyroll News itself only reported the announcement, not a Crunchyroll simulcast, https://www.crunchyroll.com/news/latest/2026/3/28/reincarnated-as-a-sword-season-2-anime-october-2026-release-date-trailer).

HIDIVE is holding the show's North American premiere screening at Anime NYC on August 22, 2026 (tomorrow, relative to this post), with a panel featuring director Shinji Ishihira and producers Yosuke Shimada and Genta Ozaki (same ANN source, Aug 16, 2026).
A manga spinoff, Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita My Dish by Itsuki Fujioka, launches the same day as the early streaming debut, September 30, on Micro Magazine's Comic Ride platform (same ANN source).

Season 1 followed a nameless man reincarnated as a sentient sword who is found by an enslaved catgirl named Fran; he burns her slave contract to free her, and the two travel together as sword and wielder through the first season's dungeon-crawling arcs (Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reincarnated_as_a_Sword; Cinemaholic episode recap, https://thecinemaholic.com/reincarnated-as-a-sword-episode-1-recap-and-ending-explained/).
